topic: 围神经元网分子密码：硫酸化、OTX2 与视觉皮层关键期门控

sources.title: Reactivation of ocular dominance plasticity in the adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Pizzorusso T, Medini P, Berardi N, Chierzi S, Fawcett JW, Maffei L
sources.used_for: landmark demonstration that ChABC-mediated PNN removal restores adult OD plasticity; PNN as molecular brake on plasticity
sources.key_finding: ChABC injection into adult rat V1 restores monocular deprivation-induced OD shifts equivalent to juvenile critical period; PNN formation coincides with CP closure and is delayed by dark rearing

sources.title: Structural and functional recovery from early monocular deprivation in adult rats
sources.authors: Pizzorusso T, Medini P, Landi S, Baldini S, Berardi N, Maffei L
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.used_for: ChABC + reverse lid suture achieves complete functional recovery from amblyopia in adult rats
sources.key_finding: Full OD recovery, visual acuity recovery, and dendritic spine density restoration after adult ChABC + reverse monocular deprivation

sources.title: Animals lacking link protein have attenuated perineuronal nets and persistent plasticity
sources.authors: Carulli D, Pizzorusso T, Kwok JCF, Putignano E, Poli A, Forostyak S, Andrews MR, Deepa SS, Glant TT, Fawcett JW
sources.used_for: Structural organization vs CSPG quantity; link protein Crtl1 essential for PNN architecture
sources.key_finding: Crtl1 KO mice have normal CSPG levels but attenuated PNNs; retain juvenile OD plasticity into adulthood; PNN architecture (not CSPG abundance) is the key brake on plasticity

sources.title: Chondroitin 6-sulfation regulates perineuronal net formation and critical period in visual cortex
sources.access_method: abstract only (paywall; not full text read)
sources.used_for: 4S/6S sulfation ratio as molecular switch for critical period timing; C6ST overexpression maintains juvenile plasticity
sources.key_finding: CS sulfation ratio (4S/6S) increases with development, correlating with CP closure; maintaining high 6S (C6ST overexpression) prevents PNN condensation and prolongs CP plasticity

sources.title: Otx2 binding to perineuronal nets persistently regulates plasticity in the mature visual cortex
sources.authors: Beurdeley M, Spatazza J, Lee HHC, Sugiyama S, Taylor A, He Z, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharyya S, Bhattacharyya U, Prochiantz A, Di Nardo AA
sources.used_for: OTX2 RK-domain binding CS-D/E; RK peptide competition reopens adult plasticity and restores amblyopia
sources.key_finding: OTX2 15-aa RK domain binds CS-D (Kd=17.9nM) and CS-E specifically; PNNs capture OTX2 in PV cells; two-threshold model (low OTX2 opens CP, high sustained OTX2 closes CP); RK peptide infusion reopens adult plasticity and restores binocular vision in amblyopic mice

sources.title: Experience-dependent transfer of Otx2 homeoprotein into the visual cortex activates postnatal plasticity
sources.authors: Sugiyama S, Di Nardo AA, Aizawa S, Matsuo I, Volovitch M, Prochiantz A, Hensch TK
sources.used_for: First description of non-cell-autonomous OTX2 transfer from retina to V1 PV cells
sources.key_finding: Retinal OTX2 transfers non-cell-autonomously into V1 PV interneurons; necessary and sufficient to open/close critical period

sources.title: Genetic Otx2 mis-localization delays critical period plasticity across brain regions
sources.authors: Lee HHC, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharyya S, Bhattacharyya U, Hensch TK
sources.used_for: OTX2 GAG-binding point mutation delays CP across V1, A1, and mPFC simultaneously; brain-wide synchronization
sources.key_finding: R36A/K37A knock-in disrupts CS-GAG binding; delays PV+ maturation and CP plasticity across visual, auditory, and prefrontal cortex; extends mPFC plasticity reduces anxiety; PNN remodeling persists beyond normal CP end

sources.title: Non-cell Autonomous OTX2 Homeoprotein Regulates Visual Cortex Plasticity Through Gadd45b/g
sources.authors: Apulei J, Kim N, Uzan A, Peyre E, Yusuf S, Gobert D, Kim SH, Bhatt DL, Di Nardo AA, Prochiantz A
sources.used_for: OTX2 downstream epigenetic mechanism via Gadd45b/g and DNA demethylation
sources.key_finding: OTX2 regulates Gadd45b/g in PV cells; Gadd45b viral overexpression in adult V1 reactivates OD plasticity; links OTX2 signaling to epigenetic chromatin remodeling

sources.title: Chondroitinase and Antidepressants Promote Plasticity by Releasing TRKB from Dephosphorylating Control of PTPσ in Parvalbumin Neurons
sources.authors: Lesnikova A, Bhattacharyya S, Bhattacharyya U, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharyya S, Castrén E
sources.used_for: Unified molecular mechanism: PNN aggrecan → PTPσ → TrkB dephosphorylation; ChABC and fluoxetine both act via TrkB:PTPσ in PV cells
sources.key_finding: PV-TRKB reduction abolishes ChABC-induced plasticity; PTPσ KO maintains adult plasticity; aggrecan suppresses pTRKB; fluoxetine disrupts TRKB:PTPσ via TM domain binding; convergent mechanism for PNN removal and antidepressant-induced plasticity

sources.title: Critical period plasticity in local cortical circuits
sources.used_for: Canonical molecular framework for critical period; GABA inhibition threshold; ECM proteolysis; BDNF acceleration
sources.key_finding: GAD65-mediated GABA inhibition threshold triggers CP onset; BDNF accelerates PV circuit maturation; ECM proteolysis consolidates structural changes during (not after) CP; PNN as molecular brake

sources.title: An Extracellular Perspective on CNS Maturation: Perineuronal Nets and the Control of Plasticity
sources.used_for: PNN molecular composition: aggrecan, brevican, hyaluronan, link proteins, tenascin-R
sources.key_finding: Comprehensive molecular anatomy of PNNs; developmental assembly timeline; therapeutic ChABC applications

sources.title: Critical period regulation across multiple timescales
sources.used_for: Gamma oscillations and CP; circadian regulation (CLOCK/BMAL1); epigenetic mechanisms (HDAC, Gadd45b); transgenerational effects
sources.key_finding: CP regulation operates across millisecond (gamma), developmental, and epigenetic timescales; CLOCK/BMAL1 in PV cells control CP onset; HDAC inhibitors reopen adult plasticity; Gadd45b demethylase links experience to epigenetics; OTX2 binds CLOCK promoter

sources.title: Developmental Changes in the Density of Perineuronal Nets Are Activity-Dependent
sources.authors: Devienne G, Picaud S, Cohen I, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharyya S, Bhattacharyya U, Castrén E, Le Van Quyen M, Bhatt DL
sources.used_for: Adult PNN density is dynamically maintained by ongoing PV cell activity (DREADD silencing for 1 week → PNN degradation)
sources.key_finding: DREADD-mediated silencing of PV cells for 1 week causes significant PNN degradation in adult cortex; CP closure state is actively maintained, not permanently locked

sources.title: Fluoxetine-induced plasticity in the visual cortex outlasts the duration of the naturally occurring critical period
sources.used_for: Fluoxetine as pharmacological critical period reopener; time course and reversibility
sources.key_finding: Chronic fluoxetine extends OD plasticity window beyond natural CP end point; window closes when treatment stops; pharmacological iPlasticity

sources.title: Non-Cell-Autonomous Factors Implicated in Parvalbumin Interneuron Maturation and Critical Periods
sources.used_for: Comprehensive review of non-cell-autonomous PV maturation signals: BDNF, SPARCL1, OTX2, myelination, hormones, circadian, immune
sources.key_finding: Convergence of choroid plexus OTX2, ECM signals, BDNF, and circadian rhythms on PV cells gates CP onset/closure; epigenetic changes mediated by these signals

summary.notes: PMID:22246436 (Miyata 2012) and PMID:18692473 (Sugiyama 2008) were read as abstracts only due to paywall; both are landmark papers whose main findings are well-established and independently confirmed by downstream studies with full text access
